sources.title: PCI approved institutions (Approved Diploma institutions u/s 12; Diploma institutions only for conduct; Approved Degree institutions u/s 12; Degree institutions only for conduct; Approved institutions for Pharm.D; Approved institutions for M.Pharm courses), decisions for the 2026-27 academic session

note: Institutions on the Pharmacy Council of India's approved lists at pci.gov.in (Approved Institutes menu: D.Pharm and B.Pharm u/s 12 and only-for-conduct lists, Pharm.D and M.Pharm lists), keyed by PCI's own institution code. PCI publishes no address, city or management type. Intake appears only inside PCI's free-text decision, so seats are filled only where that decision states an intake for an approval covering 2026-27 (for example 'Extend approval upto 2026-2027 academic session for 60 admissions', a first-year grant for 2026-27, or a raise in intake from 2026-27); decisions that give no intake, or whose stated approval ends before 2026-27, leave seats null. Courses PCI approved only from 2027-28 are left out. M.Pharm specialisations are listed as branches where PCI names them; the M.Pharm total is filled only when every specialisation has a stated intake. Pharm.D (Post Baccalaureate) and the B.Pharm (Practice) bridge course are not included. The university is the examining authority PCI lists for the degree courses.
